# Qubizon Digital Solutions
> Unified digital agency specializing in high-performance Next.js web development, technical SEO, social media marketing, and paid advertising in Kerala.

## Services
- [Website Development](https://qubizon.com/services/web-development): Custom Next.js web application engineering and sub-second page performance.
- [Search Engine Optimization](https://qubizon.com/services/seo): Technical SEO audits, semantic schema graphs, and search-intent clustering.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://qubizon.com/services/social-media-marketing): Multi-channel brand positioning, thought leadership, and organic reach.
- [Paid Advertising](https://qubizon.com/services/paid-advertising): Precision Google Ads and Meta paid acquisition with ROAS tracking.
- [Content Marketing](https://qubizon.com/services/content-marketing): High-authority B2B editorial and topical authority content silos.

## Service Areas
- [Kozhikode](https://qubizon.com/locations/kozhikode): Web development and digital marketing for Kozhikode businesses.
- [Thrissur](https://qubizon.com/locations/thrissur): Enterprise web engineering and paid advertising for Thrissur businesses.
- [All Kerala Hubs](https://qubizon.com/locations): Digital agency solutions across Kerala.
